dipper.basis: Holling intake on refuge-cell benthic+emergent; shared-foraging-ground assumption; simultaneous pro-rata competition with trout

provenance.food: relative: per-cell production normalized by the daily maximum (absolute starvation unrepresentable); cells carrying food_scale (tributary pockets, authored area ratio) rank on scaled production (mean scale 1.0000 over 276 cells, 0 scaled)
provenance.limitations: no emergent drift; no molluscs (warm food underestimated); single trout, single dipper; no mortality simulation
provenance.shear_coupling: bed_shear_pa -> disturbance ramp 0@20.0Pa to 1@2x; None shear -> 0; mean applied 0.0000 over 276 cells (3 shear-null)
provenance.velocity: mapped hydraulics continuity velocity; representative fallback where absent

trout.refuge_reason: cell firehole_cell_00065 at s=1280 m (U -0.057, 17.53 C) selected by brown_trout literature suitability over 276 replay cells

parameter_provenance.method: 14-day insect/trout/dipper food web on replay time-mean thermal landscape
